commitResults.messageBody:
Resolves #155. Updated VALIDATION_REGEX in Name.java to accept hyphens,
commas, and apostrophes in addition to alphanumeric characters and spaces,
matching real-world name formats like O'Brien, Mary-Jane, and Lim, Junior.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix mark command to allow flexible ordering of t/ and w/ prefixes
commitResults.messageBody:
Resolves #154. ArgumentTokenizer requires whitespace before any prefix, so
inputs starting with w/ (e.g. "w/2 t/T01") were not parsed correctly. Now
a leading space is prepended for both t/ and w/ prefix-leading inputs,
enabling flexible ordering consistent with other commands.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Enforce phone number uniqueness on add and edit
commitResults.messageBody:
Resolves #158. Added hasPersonWithPhone(Phone, Person) to AddressBook,
Model, and ModelManager. AddCommand now rejects a new person whose phone
is already in use; EditCommand rejects an edit that would assign a phone
already held by a different person.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Enforce email uniqueness on add and edit
commitResults.messageBody:
Resolves #157. Added hasPersonWithEmail(Email, Person) to AddressBook,
Model, and ModelManager. AddCommand now rejects a new person whose email
is already in use; EditCommand rejects an edit that would assign an email
already held by a different person.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
